newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS-Vereinsbank plans build on profit rise.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Vereinsbank plans build on profit rise.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG on Tuesday said it had set ambitious profit goals for 1997 after buoyant market conditions helped it post an 18 percent rise in 1996 operating earnings.

Chief executive Albrecht Schmidt told a news conference the bank was confident of "building on last year's improved profitability" and said business at the start of 1997 had already surpassed expectations.

The Bavarian mortgage specialist reported operating profits of around 1.6 billion marks ($940 million) for last year -- at the upper end of forecasts -- amid strong advances in interest and commission earnings in what proved a boom year for financial markets.

While Vereinsbank did not release a precise net profit figure for the year, Schmidt said net earnings rose some 30 percent and the bank is planning to raise its dividend to 1.60 marks per shares from 1.50 marks.
